summary: Adds absorption-law rewrites (a AND (a OR b) => a, a OR (a AND b) => a) to RexSimplify for AND, AND-unknown-as-false, and OR, guarded by a 20-term cap and a determinism check, and updates plans in existing tests.

tests.evidence: New simplification behavior; RexProgramTest.testAbsorptionLaw and testAbsorptionLawWithNonDeterministic cover both directions, nullable and filter mode, and a non-deterministic negative case; many expected plans in sub-query.iq and JdbcAdapterTest change and needed explaining (author annotated them inline).

user_docs.evidence: Internal simplifier rule; no option or documented behavior changes.

doc_comments.evidence: New private absorb() has an accurate Javadoc including the determinism requirement; nothing contradicts.

change_description.evidence: PR body is only the Jira link plus a note that other tests were simplified; plan changes were explained in review comments rather than the description.

performance.evidence: RexSimplify is on the planning hot path; mihaibudiu flagged the disjunctions/conjunctions calls as not cheap (O(n^2*m)), answered by the MAX_TERMS_FOR_ABSORPTION = 20 guard; asolimando stressed machine-generated large predicates.

security.evidence: No untrusted input, auth, or resource handling.

backward_compat.evidence: Simplified output and plans change for existing queries (sub-query.iq, JdbcAdapterTest, MaterializedViewSubstitutionVisitorTest), which users with plan-based tests may notice; semantics are preserved.

correctness.evidence: Non-trivial rewrite in three-valued logic, applied in both UNKNOWN and FALSE modes, with in-place list mutation (terms.remove(i); i--) inside nested iteration; needs a careful check of null semantics and identity-vs-equals term matching.

user_value.evidence: Optimization with visible benefit (smaller plans, dropped helper columns); no API surface.

surprising_behavior.evidence: Equivalence-preserving rewrite; nothing a user would find unexpected.

contradictions.evidence: Comments, Javadoc and tests agree with the code.

spec_conformance.evidence: Absorption holds under SQL three-valued (Kleene) logic, so NULL semantics conform; a quick check suffices.

plan.why: Small cohesive change to one simplifier method; one reviewer can cover logic, cost, and tests together.
